title: Ning Li's last talk was at a MITRE conference before she went black

tellings.quote: Ning Lee was last you know speaking at a meer conference before she kind of went into the black

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a physicist named Ning Li. He says her last public talk was at a conference held by MITRE, a US research organisation that does work for the government, and that after that she went into the black, meaning she seemed to vanish into secret, classified work. He tells it as a sign that her research may have been taken out of public view.
